sentences.text: This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

01.
2. Heard Mr. M.K. Mohapatro, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr. S.N. Nayak,
learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the State-opposite parties.
3.

According to Mr. Mohapatro, the petitioner is aggrieved by the non-disposal of his application filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 styled as L.A. Misc. Case No. 113 of 2014 arising out of L.A.C. No. 01 of 2007 pending before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Upper Indravati irrigation Project, Kalahandi (opposite party no.3).
In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to the opposite party No.3 to dispose of the said case expeditiously.

4. Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court disposes of the writ petition directing the opposite party No.3 to dispose of the L.A. Misc.
Case No. 113 of 2014 arising out of L.A. Case No. 01 of 2007 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner.

It is further directed that in case the application of the petitioner under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is allowed, and if there is no other legal impediment, the compensation amount be disbursed in favour of the petitioner within a period of two months thereafter.
5. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G.SATAPATHY) JUDGE S.Sasmal Location: High Court of Orissa Arjun Sahoo vs State Of Odisha & Others .....
